description: 类型别名接收者展开（aster-lang-core#313，ADR 0056 修订 A7 D1）的双引擎 parity 夹具。aster-lang-ts shared/alias_receiver_parity.json 与 aster-lang-core src/test/resources/diagnostics/alias_receiver_parity.json 必须 byte-identical。R2 把别名类型逐层展开为目标类型（成环时停在别名名上），点分路径接收者、Match 主语与期望类型与直接写目标类型时解析结果相同。词汇（en-US）：Struct Driver↔Fahrer，Field Driver.age↔alter，EnumValue Level.High↔Hoch、Level.Low↔Niedrig。codes 为 R1 + R2 的全部诊断 [码, 行]（含 warning），按报告顺序；refs（无 error 时）为规范 Core IR 里全部 Func 体内 Name / PatName（kind:name）与 PatCtor（PatCtor:typeName）的出现，按对象键字典序深度优先。

cases.name: 对照：接收者直接写目标类型，本地化字段名按类型解析
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Rule f given x as Fahrer, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.

cases.name: 别名接收者：本地化字段名按目标类型解析，无 W801
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.

cases.name: 别名接收者：规范字段名
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Return x.age.

cases.name: 别名链逐层展开
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type A as Fz.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as A, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.

cases.name: 字段类型是别名：下一段按目标类型解析
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Define Halter has fz as Fz.

Rule f given h as Halter, produce Int:
  Return h.fz.alter.

cases.name: 被调函数返回别名类型：Let 的字段按目标类型解析
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule g given x as Fahrer, produce Fz:
  Return x.

Rule f given x as Fahrer, produce Int:
  Let y be g(x).
  Return y.alter.

cases.name: E801 别名目标类型没有该字段（字段属于另一个 Data）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Return x.y.

cases.name: E801 别名目标类型与任何 Data 都没有该字段
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Return x.zzz.

cases.name: 别名目标是 Map：点分段是动态键，原样保留
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type M as Map Text to Int.

Rule f given m as M, produce Int:
  Return m.alter.

cases.name: 别名目标是内置标量：点分段原样保留
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type T as Text.

Rule f given m as T, produce Int:
  Return m.foo.

cases.name: Match 主语为枚举别名：本地化裸名是成员
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type L as Level.

Rule f given s as L, produce Int:
  Match s:
    When Hoch, Return 1.
    When Niedrig, Return 2.

cases.name: Match 主语为枚举别名：规范裸名是成员
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type L as Level.

Rule f given s as L, produce Int:
  Match s:
    When High, Return 1.
    When Low, Return 2.

cases.name: Match 主语为 Data 别名：构造器模式按目标类型解析
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Match x:
    When Fahrer(a), Return a.

cases.name: 返回类型为枚举别名：本地化裸名是成员
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type L as Level.

Rule f given x as Int, produce L:
  Return Hoch.

cases.name: 实参类型为枚举别名：本地化裸名是成员
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type L as Level.

Rule g given l as L, produce Int:
  Return 1.

Rule f given x as Int, produce Int:
  Return g(Hoch).

cases.name: W801 别名成环：按未知类型名，全局唯一候选采用
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type A as B.

Type B as A.

Rule f given x as A, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.

cases.name: W801 别名目标是可空类型：包装类型照旧按未知（ADR 0051 R20）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type Fz as Fahrer?.

Rule f given x as Fz, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.

cases.name: E801 类型参数与别名同名：类型参数优先，没有字段
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Fahrer has alter as Int.

Define Other has y as Int.

Define Level as one of Hoch, Niedrig.

Type T as Fahrer.

Rule f of T given x as T, produce Int:
  Return x.alter.
